notes.title: [Patch] Windows 10
notes.content:
Dear community, 

First thank your for your feedbacks. 

Now people who use [b] windows 10 [/b] will be able to play the game.

Note: Sometimes when you are loading a new game a crash might occur. We are still investigating and will post a new update for this one.
